title: Functional-assay calibration to ACMG/AMP evidence — clean-room reimpl of rosstewart/exCALIBR (Zeiberg et al. bioRxiv 2025). Bootstrap constrained skew-normal mixture EM + Bayesian (Tavtigian) calibration turns MAVE / VAMP-seq / SGE scores into PS3 / BS3 evidence strengths. Subcommands: thresholds, prepare, run, assign, selftest.
summary: exCALIBR — functional-assay calibration to ACMG/AMP evidence (IGVFagent port).

tools.name: calibrate_assign
tools.description: Apply an existing calibration to a table of assay scores: each score gets its evidence point value and the ACMG/AMP criterion + strength it supports (e.g. 'PS3 moderate', 'BS3 strong', 'no evidence'). USE THIS after calibrate_run, or with a published calibration JSON, to interpret new variants.

calibration.description: Path to a *_calibration.json from calibrate run.

scores.description: CSV/TSV with a score column (plus any ID columns).

tools.name: calibrate_prepare
tools.description: Build the score/sample input table a calibration needs. Labels variants into the four calibration samples — 0 P/LP and 1 B/LB from ClinVar (with a review-star quality gate), 2 population from gnomAD membership, 3 synonymous — from an IGVF / Pillar-format scoreset (`pillar`), a plain score/sample CSV (`table`), or a `mavedb map-scoreset` output joined to ClinVar (`mapped` + `clinvar_tsv`). Reports the per-sample counts so you can see whether the scoreset has enough labelled variants to calibrate at all.

mapped.description: mavedb map-scoreset output with chr/pos/ref/alt + score.

tools.name: calibrate_run
tools.description: CALIBRATE A FUNCTIONAL ASSAY TO ACMG/AMP EVIDENCE ★. Full exCALIBR chain (Zeiberg et al. 2025) on a variant-effect scoreset: bootstrap constrained skew-normal mixture EM over the P/LP, B/LB, gnomAD-population and synonymous samples → EM prior → LR+(score) → Tavtigian C → the score window that earns each evidence strength (PS3 / BS3 supporting → very strong), plus 2c-vs-3c model selection, a calibration JSON and a figure. Input is either an IGVF / Pillar-format scoreset CSV (`pillar`) or a score/sample table from calibrate prepare (`table`). LONG JOB: runs to completion in one call with a progress heartbeat and a resumable ledger — lower `n_bootstraps` / `fits_per_bootstrap` for a quick look (defaults 1000 x 100 are the paper's settings).

pillar.description: Path to an IGVF / Pillar-format scoreset CSV (carries auth_reported_score + ClinVar + gnomAD + SpliceAI).

table.description: Path to a score/sample CSV (from calibrate prepare).

name.description: Dataset name; also selects one Dataset from a multi-dataset Pillar table.

tools.name: calibrate_thresholds
tools.description: ACMG/AMP EVIDENCE THRESHOLDS FROM A PRIOR ★. Solves Tavtigian's constant C (O_PVSt) for a given prior probability of pathogenicity and prints the likelihood-ratio (LR+) threshold for every evidence strength — supporting / moderate / strong / very strong, on both the PS3 (pathogenic) and BS3 (benign) sides. Instant, no data or fitting needed. USE THIS to answer 'how strong must an assay LR+ be to count as PS3 moderate?' or to sanity-check a published calibration.

prior.description: P(pathogenic) in the reference population, e.g. 0.1 for a well-studied disease gene, 0.01 for a low-prior gene.

point_values.description: Comma list of evidence point values (default 1..8).
